title: Galician Stew
description: A hearty, flavorful stew originating from Galicia, Spain. This recipe serves 4-6 people and can be cooked in under an hour.

ingredients.name: Potatoes
ingredients.notes: Choose high-starch potatoes like Russet or Idaho

ingredients.name: Quick Galician Stew
ingredients.notes: Available in most supermarkets or specialty stores

instructions: Heat water in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the contents of the Galician Stew package.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.
Add sliced potatoes and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
